name: Sato Kasumi
source:
Area: Tokyo

[url=/c70696]Shigeru's[/url] younger step sister after his father remarried. A kind girl who looks after her blind brother, feeds him her homemade sweets and reads him stories.

Her life completely changes when Shigeru's eyes open up, however...
